headline: Excited to share the study behind Google's Hypertension Alert in @natureportfolio.nature.com! I was fortunate to participate as a coauthor.
author: @spjuraschek.bsky.social
text:
Excited to share the study behind Google's Hypertension Alert in @natureportfolio.nature.com! I was fortunate to participate as a coauthor.

A positive alert should be followed by a cuff assessment, but I'm optimistic it could lead to earlier detection. More to come! 

www.nature.com/articles/s41...
